column1: # Supplementary standard thermodynamic data (298.15 K, 1 bar) for substances
# that are not CODATA key values. Values from CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics
# (84th ed., via the LibreTexts "T1" table) or, where marked, the NBS-derived
# OpenStax Chemistry 2e Appendix G. Every row passed: (1) internal consistency
# dfG = dfH - T*dfS within 3 kJ/mol, (2) no disagreement > 2 kJ/mol or 2 J/(K mol)
# with another consistent source, and the confirming sources are listed
# (crc, nbs = OpenStax App. G, wb = NIST Chemistry WebBook). Rows that disagree
# with the NIST WebBook are left out. N2O4(g) is taken from NIST-JANAF
# (M. W. Chase, 1998) because the CRC value (11.1 kJ/mol) contradicts the
# measured Kp of 2NO2 = N2O4 (about 6.7 at 25 C).
